leave_absence_reporting_013.evidence: When it is necessary for an employee in the Certified Unit to be absent, except in emergency situations, the employee will notify the principal or building administrator at least seventy-two (72) hours before they are to be absent by completing a PTO form. In emergency/unforeseen situations, the employee shall notify the principal by 6:00 am the day the employee is to be gone by putting the absence on the sub system and contacting the principal.
